name: Midori Timer
description: A timer whose duration you type: 25m, 1h30, 90s or 1:30, in a small window a hotkey can open. Shows as a thin line just inside an edge of the note that fills as the time runs: the whole line is sage, then the whole line is ochre, then the whole line is wine, so how long is left reads at a glance. It appears only while a timer is going, is trimmed clear of the status bar on desktop and of the header and navigation pills on mobile, and resets itself when the time is up. A status-bar readout is available instead of it or alongside it. Counts against an absolute deadline rather than decrementing a number, so it stays accurate while the window is in the background or the machine sleeps, and survives a restart.
author: Benjamin Loschen
